newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foster's Brewing shares suspended on TSE.
newsitem.headline: Foster's Brewing shares suspended on TSE.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd shares were suspended from trade on the foreign stocks section of the Tokyo bourse on Thursday after trade in the shares was halted on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), brokers said.
The ASX said the halt was pending an announcement to be made by the company about major transactions relating to more than 50 percent of Foster's issued ordinary capital.
Foster's later said it would buy back 254.5 million of its shares from Asahi Breweries Ltd for A$625 million.
The leading Australian brewer said it would pay Asahi A$2.49 for each of the shares, which represent the bulk of Asahi's 270.3 million shareholding and about 13 percent of Foster's fully paid shares.
Asahi Breweries ended Tokyo trade up 20 yen at 1,660 yen.
